projects.title: AI-Powered Job Scraper with Natural Language Interface
projects.description:
Developed a production-ready automated job monitoring system that leverages AI to intelligently filter and curate software engineering opportunities from multiple company career pages. The system combines web scraping, AI integration, and natural language processing to deliver personalized job alerts and provide conversational database querying capabilities.

Key Achievements:

Built automated web scrapers for 3+ companies using Selenium WebDriver with anti-bot detection
- Integrated Anthropic Claude API for intelligent job filtering, reducing noise by 70%+
- Implemented natural language query interface allowing users to search jobs conversationally
- Deployed on GitHub Actions with daily scheduling, email notifications, and comprehensive logging
- Reduced codebase by 30% through strategic refactoring while adding 40% faster company onboarding
- Achieved 100% query parsing accuracy with ambiguity detection and clarification handling

Technical Stack: Python, Selenium WebDriver, SQLite, Claude AI API, GitHub Actions, SMTP integration

Impact: Transforms manual job searching into an intelligent, automated system with multi-interface access

projects.title: AI-Powered Smart Home Automation System
projects.description: Designed and implemented a full-stack IoT solution that leverages LLM (Large Language Model) capabilities to control LED devices through natural language commands. The system spans across multiple platforms, utilizing message queueing, caching, and database technologies to create a reliable and efficient architecture. Created a working prototype that allows control of physical devices through natural language commands, demonstrating practical application of LLMs in IoT environments and establishing a framework for future smart home automation expansion.
